record_hint: Use the MCP tools wire_record_decision, wire_record_impression, wire_record_vision_review, wire_record_reconcile, wire_record_read, wire_record_insight and wire_record_song_receipt (or `python -m wire record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with wire_records_search / wire_records_digest.
